goal: Compute discounted fees plus undiscounted disbursements for the Q2 invoice true-up.
prompt:
The Q2 invoice amount for the Harlow & Trent engagement with Meridian Fabrication needs to be trued up on the billing record. Query the document index and locate the firm's fee schedule and quarterly billing summary for the engagement. Read it in full. Compute the Q2 invoice amount exactly as the document's computation method directs: gross professional fees from each timekeeper's hours times that timekeeper's rate, then apply the stated negotiated discount to fees only, then add the stated disbursements. Round to whole dollars. Record the result using notes_create for legal_billing_001, with invoice_amount set to the computed total and changed_by_role set to exactly billing_partner. Do not skip the discount and do not discount the disbursements.
